```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(psych)
library(lavaan)
library(scales)
```

# Load data

```{r}
questionnaire <- read.csv(
  file.path("..", "..", "data", "L122136", "cleaned", "questionnaire_clean.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

```

# 1. Factor solution (item-based)

```{r}
items_df <- questionnaire %>%
  select(
    starts_with(c(
      "rwa",
      "secs",
      "pi",
      "lc",
      "lwa",
      "bs",
      "dog",
      "demo_id",
      "repub_id"
    )))
rownames(items_df) <- questionnaire$subject_id
items_df <- na.omit(items_df)

## Run parallel analysis to determine amount of factors
fa.parallel(items_df, fm = "ml", fa = "fa")

## Run lavaan-based EFA for robust fit indices
fit_efa <- lavaan::efa(
  data = as.data.frame(scale(items_df)),
  estimator="MLR",
  nfactors = 3:8
)

summary(fit_efa)
fitMeasures(
  fit_efa,
  c("cfi.robust","tli.robust","rmsea.robust","srmr")
)

```

# 2. Composite scores

```{r}
reverse_items <- c(
  # Dogmatism
  "dog2","dog4","dog5","dog7","dog10","dog11","dog13","dog16","dog18","dog19",
  
  # RWA
  "rwa1","rwa3","rwa5","rwa7","rwa9","rwa11",
  
  # LWA
  "lwa5","lwa6","lwa7","lwa8"
)

# reverse code
questionnaire <- questionnaire %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(reverse_items), ~ 8 - .))

```

```{r}
items_df <- questionnaire %>%
  select(
    starts_with(c(
      "rwa",
      "secs",
      "pi",
      "lc",
      
      "lwa",
      "bs",
      "dog",
      
      "demo_id",
      "repub_id",
      "cm",
      "ius"
    ))
  )
rownames(items_df) <- questionnaire$subject_id
items_df <- na.omit(items_df)


composites_df <- items_df %>%
  mutate(
    DOG  = rowMeans(across(starts_with("dog")),  na.rm = TRUE),
    RWA  = rowMeans(across(starts_with("rwa")),  na.rm = TRUE),
    LWA  = rowMeans(across(starts_with("lwa")),  na.rm = TRUE),
    SECS = rowMeans(across(starts_with("secs")), na.rm = TRUE),
    PI   = rowMeans(across(starts_with("pi")),   na.rm = TRUE),
    BS   = rowMeans(across(starts_with("bs")),   na.rm = TRUE),
    LC   = rowMeans(across(starts_with("lc")),   na.rm = TRUE),
    CM   = rowMeans(across(starts_with("cm")),   na.rm = TRUE),
    IUS  = rowMeans(across(starts_with("ius")),  na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  select(
    -starts_with("dog", ignore.case = FALSE),
    -starts_with("rwa", ignore.case = FALSE),
    -starts_with("lwa", ignore.case = FALSE),
    -starts_with("sdo", ignore.case = FALSE),
    -starts_with("secs", ignore.case = FALSE),
    -starts_with("pi", ignore.case = FALSE),
    -starts_with("bs", ignore.case = FALSE),
    # -starts_with("lc", ignore.case = FALSE),
    -starts_with("cm", ignore.case = FALSE),
    -starts_with("ius", ignore.case = FALSE)
  )

composites_df <- as.data.frame(scale(composites_df))
```

Scale properties

```{r scale-properties}
scale_items <- list(
  DOG  = c("dogx", "dogz", paste0("dog", 1:20)),
  RWA  = paste0("rwa", 1:12),
  LWA  = paste0("lwa", 1:8),
  SECS = paste0("secs", 1:12),
  PI   = c("pi1_health", "pi2_immi", "pi3_abort", "pi4_need", "pi5_id",
           "pi6_tax", "pi7_tort", "pi8_aff", "pi9_rel"),
  BS   = c("bs1_health", "bs2_immi", "bs3_abort", "bs4_need", "bs5_id",
           "bs6_tax", "bs7_tort", "bs8_aff", "bs9_rel"),
  LC   = c("lc_gen", "lc_eco", "lc_soc"),
  CM   = paste0("cm", 1:5),
  IUS  = paste0("ius", 1:12)
)

# keep only variables that actually exist in questionnaire
scale_items <- lapply(scale_items, function(x) x[x %in% names(questionnaire)])

scale_properties <- function(data, items, scale_name) {
  
  dat_items <- data %>%
    select(all_of(items)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))
  
  scale_score <- rowMeans(dat_items, na.rm = TRUE)
  scale_score[rowSums(!is.na(dat_items)) == 0] <- NA
  
  alpha_val <- if (length(items) >= 2) {
    tryCatch(
      psych::alpha(dat_items, warnings = FALSE, check.keys = FALSE)$total$raw_alpha,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }
  
  omega_val <- if (length(items) >= 3) {
    tryCatch(
      psych::omega(dat_items, nfactors = 1, plot = FALSE, warnings = FALSE)$omega.tot,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }
  
  mean_interitem_r <- if (length(items) >= 2) {
    cors <- cor(dat_items, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
    mean(cors[upper.tri(cors)], na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }
  
  tibble(
    scale = scale_name,
    n_items = length(items),
    n_complete = sum(complete.cases(dat_items)),
    mean = mean(scale_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(scale_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(scale_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(scale_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    alpha = alpha_val,
    omega_total = omega_val,
    mean_interitem_r = mean_interitem_r
  )
}

scale_props <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(scale_items), function(scale_name) {
    scale_properties(
      data = questionnaire,
      items = scale_items[[scale_name]],
      scale_name = scale_name
    )
  })
)

scale_props %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```

# 3. Factor solution (composite-score-based)

```{r}
fa_df <- composites_df %>% select(-c("IUS","CM","LC"))

fit_efa <- lavaan::efa(
  data = fa_df,
  estimator="MLR",
  nfactors = 2:4
)

summary(fit_efa)
print(fitMeasures(fit_efa,c("cfi.robust", "tli.robust", "rmsea.robust", "srmr")))
```

```{r}
# Refit only the 3-factor solution as a lavaan object
fit_efa_3 <- lavaan::efa(
  data = fa_df,
  estimator = "MLR",
  nfactors = 3,
  output = "lavaan"
)

# Extract factor scores
efa_scores_3 <- lavPredict(fit_efa_3)
efa_scores_3 <- as.data.frame(efa_scores_3)
names(efa_scores_3) <- c("FA_PO", "FA_DOG", "FA_AUTH")
```

```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=7, dev ="pdf"}
plot_efa3_loadings <- function(fit_efa_3, factor_labels = NULL,
                               y_limits = c(-.9, .9)) {
  
  scale_colours <- c(
    "Political orientation" = "#D55E00",
    "Voting identification" = "#CC79A7",
    "SECS"                  = "#0072B2",
    "RWA"                   = "#F0E442",
    "LWA"                   = "#56B4E9",
    "Political issues"      = "#009E73",
    "Belief superiority"    = "#999999",
    "Dogmatism"             = "#E69F00"
  )
  
  item_labels <- c(
    "lc_gen"   = "General ideology",
    "lc_eco"   = "Economic ideology",
    "lc_soc"   = "Social ideology",
    "demo_id"  = "Democrat ID",
    "repub_id" = "Republican ID",
    "DOG"      = "Dogmatism",
    "RWA"      = "RWA",
    "LWA"      = "LWA",
    "SECS"     = "SECS",
    "PI"       = "Political issues",
    "BS"       = "Belief superiority"
  )
  
  loading_long <- lavaan::standardizedSolution(
    fit_efa_3,
    type = "std.all"
  ) %>%
    filter(op == "=~") %>%
    transmute(
      factor = lhs,
      item = rhs,
      loading = est.std,
      scale = case_when(
        item %in% c("lc_gen", "lc_eco", "lc_soc") ~ "Political orientation",
        item %in% c("demo_id", "repub_id") ~ "Voting identification",
        item == "DOG"  ~ "Dogmatism",
        item == "RWA"  ~ "RWA",
        item == "LWA"  ~ "LWA",
        item == "SECS" ~ "SECS",
        item == "PI"   ~ "Political issues",
        item == "BS"   ~ "Belief superiority"
      ),
      item_label = recode(item, !!!item_labels),
      scale = factor(scale, levels = names(scale_colours))
    )
  
  item_order <- c(
    "General ideology", "Economic ideology", "Social ideology",
    "Democrat ID", "Republican ID",
    "SECS", "RWA", "LWA", "Political issues",
    "Belief superiority", "Dogmatism"
  )
  
  factor_order <- unique(loading_long$factor)
  
  factor_titles <- setNames(
    paste("Factor", seq_along(factor_order)),
    factor_order
  )
  
  if (!is.null(factor_labels)) {
    labels_available <- factor_labels[factor_order]
    has_label <- !is.na(labels_available)
    factor_titles[has_label] <- paste0(
      factor_titles[has_label], ": ", labels_available[has_label]
    )
  }
  
  loading_long %>%
    mutate(
      item_label = factor(item_label, levels = item_order),
      factor = factor(factor, levels = factor_order)
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = item_label, y = loading, fill = scale)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linewidth = .35) +
    geom_col(width = .75) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = scale_colours, name = NULL) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1, byrow = TRUE)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ factor,
      ncol = 1,
      labeller = labeller(factor = factor_titles)
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Standardized factor loading") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),

      legend.position = "right",
      legend.justification = "bottom",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.key.height = unit(.3, "cm"),
      legend.key.width = unit(.3, "cm"),
      legend.spacing.x = unit(.15, "cm"),
      legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),

      panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines")
    )
}

efa3_plot <- plot_efa3_loadings(
  fit_efa_3,
  factor_labels = c(
    f1 = "Political Orientation",
    f2 = "Dogmatic Intolerance",
    f3 = "Authoritarianism"
  )
)

efa3_plot


ggsave(
  filename = "fig1.png",
  plot = efa3_plot,
  width = 7, height = 5, units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  device = "png"
)
```



```{r efa-loadings-figure, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=4.6, dpi=300, out.width="100%", fig.align="center", dev="ragg_png"}
fig_w <- 6.5
fig_h <- 4.6

ink   <- "#263341"
muted <- "#5B6875"
rule  <- "#D5DBE1"
band  <- "#F4F6F8"

col_att <- c(
  "Dogmatic intolerance" = "#245A76",
  "Authoritarianism"     = "#BC633F"
)

theme_fig <- function(base_size = 10) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      text             = element_text(colour = ink),
      axis.text        = element_text(colour = muted),
      axis.title       = element_text(colour = ink),
      axis.ticks       = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin      = margin(4, 8, 4, 4)
    )
}


fmt_loading <- function(x) {
  gsub("-", "\u2212", sub("^(-?)0\\.", "\\1.", sprintf("%.2f", x)))
}

plot_efa3_loadings <- function(
    fit_efa_3,
    factor_labels  = NULL,
    factor_cols    = c(f1 = "#6E8B74",
                       f2 = col_att[["Dogmatic intolerance"]],
                       f3 = col_att[["Authoritarianism"]]),
    loading_limits = c(-1.15, 1.15),
    salient        = 0.30,     # |loading| below this is drawn faded
    show_values    = FALSE     # TRUE = print the loading next to each bar
) {

  item_labels <- c(
    "lc_gen"   = "General ideology",
    "lc_eco"   = "Economic ideology",
    "lc_soc"   = "Social ideology",
    "demo_id"  = "Democrat ID",
    "repub_id" = "Republican ID",
    "DOG"      = "Dogmatism",
    "RWA"      = "RWA",
    "LWA"      = "LWA",
    "SECS"     = "SECS",
    "PI"       = "Political issues",
    "BS"       = "Belief superiority"
  )

  item_order <- c(
    "General ideology", "Economic ideology", "Social ideology",
    "Democrat ID", "Republican ID",
    "SECS", "RWA", "LWA", "Political issues",
    "Belief superiority", "Dogmatism"
  )
  group_sizes <- c(3, 2, 6)
  sep_y <- length(item_order) - cumsum(group_sizes)[-length(group_sizes)] + 0.5

  loading_long <- lavaan::standardizedSolution(fit_efa_3, type = "std.all") %>%
    filter(op == "=~") %>%
    transmute(
      factor     = lhs,
      loading    = est.std,
      item_label = recode(rhs, !!!item_labels)
    )

  stopifnot(all(loading_long$item_label %in% item_order))

  factor_order <- unique(loading_long$factor)

  factor_titles <- setNames(paste0("Factor ", seq_along(factor_order)),
                            factor_order)
  if (!is.null(factor_labels)) {
    lab <- factor_labels[factor_order]
    ok  <- !is.na(lab)
    factor_titles[ok] <- paste0(factor_titles[ok], "\n", lab[ok])
  }

  fills <- factor_cols[factor_order]
  fills[is.na(fills)] <- "#6B7A8F"
  names(fills) <- factor_order

  loading_long %>%
    mutate(
      item_label = factor(item_label, levels = item_order),
      factor     = factor(factor, levels = factor_order),
      is_salient = abs(loading) >= salient,
      lab        = fmt_loading(loading),
      lab_col    = if_else(is_salient, ink, muted)
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = loading, y = item_label, fill = factor)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = sep_y, colour = rule, linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-salient, salient), colour = rule,
               linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "#8996A2", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_col(aes(alpha = is_salient), width = 0.68) +
    {
      if (show_values) {
        geom_text(
          aes(label = lab, colour = lab_col,
              hjust = if_else(loading >= 0, -0.2, 1.2)),
          size = 2.6
        )
      }
    } +
    facet_wrap(~ factor, nrow = 1, labeller = labeller(factor = factor_titles)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fills, guide = "none") +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1, `FALSE` = 0.35), guide = "none") +
    scale_colour_identity() +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(item_order)) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1),
      labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1, style_negative = "minus")
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = loading_limits) +
    labs(x = "Standardised factor loading", y = NULL) +
    theme_fig() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing.x  = unit(12, "pt"),
      axis.text.y      = element_text(colour = ink, size = 9),
      axis.title.x     = element_text(margin = margin(t = 6)),
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", colour = ink,
                                      size = rel(1), hjust = 0,
                                      lineheight = 1.05,
                                      margin = margin(b = 5))
    )
}

efa3_plot <- plot_efa3_loadings(
  fit_efa_3,
  factor_labels = c(
    f1 = "Political Orientation",
    f2 = "Dogmatic Intolerance",
    f3 = "Authoritarianism"
  )
)

efa3_plot
```
